results.title: Colombia World Cup 2026: Fixtures, manager, squad depth and tactical analysis
highlights:
# Colombia World Cup 2026: Fixtures, manager, squad depth and tactical analysis
[...]
Colombia are preparing for their return to the World Cup finals, after missing out in Qatar four years ago.
[...]
Now 34 years of age, James is still skippering Colombia, and this will surely be his last crack on the biggest stage, while the likes of Bayern Munich’s Luis Diaz will provide a serious attacking threat.
[...]
• Key stat: Luis Diaz has scored 21 goals in 72 international appearances, already putting him in fourth place on the list of Colombia’s all-time leading scorers.
[...]
• Key stat: James Rodriguez was the top scorer at the 2014 World Cup in Brazil with six goals, also making him his country’s leading marksman in the competition.
[...]
Jefferson Lerma has been booked seven times in the Premier League this season, despite only starting 18 games. The Crystal Palace man was carded twice at the Copa America in 2024 and indeed has been shown 15 cards across his international career. He’ll be tasked with breaking up opposition moves.
[...]
The youngest member of this Colombia squad, Gustavo Puerta will be hoping for a break-out tournament after a strong first season with Racing Santander in Spain. The 22 year old, who previously spent a season on loan at Hull City from Bayer Leverkusen is unlikely to be a first-choice start, but he is a physical midfielder who can help his team at both ends of the pitch.
[...]
: 5.33 per match (first)
[...]
Lorenzo tends to prefer a 4-2-3-1 formation, with his sides providing a lot of physicality.
[...]
There is a strong Premier League presence within the squad. That is whether it be players currently plying their trade there in Munoz, Lerma and Arias, along with former stars James, Diaz, Ospina and Sanchez.
[...]
Experience isn’t lacking either, with record appearance maker Ospina still going strong between the sticks at the age of 37, and James approaching his 36th year.
[...]
James will pull the strings in the attacking midfield role behind the chosen centre-forward for Colombia, although that won’t be former Aston Villa man Jhon Duran who has been left out of the squad.
[...]
Nestor Lorenzo is a man with no shortage of experience around the Colombia camp. He was assistant to Jose Pekerman during their two previous World Cup ventures in 2014 and 2018.
[...]
Lorenzo has followed that up by steering them back into the World Cup finals, and he has plenty of experience to draw upon when he leads them in the tournament.
[...]
It should be James Rodriguez. The playmaker won the Golden Boot in 2014, as his six goals helped Los Cafeteros reach the quarter-finals.

results.title: Luis Diaz and James Rodriguez headline Colombia World Cup squad
highlights:
Luis Diaz and James Rodriguez headline Colombia World Cup squad
[...]
Nestor Lorenzo has named his 26-man Colombia squad for the FIFA World Cup 2026.
[...]
Nestor Lorenzo has unveiled the 26-man squad for the FIFA World Cup 2026™, where Colombia will take on Congo DR, Portugal and Uzbekistan in Group K.
[...]
The Argentinian manager will have at his disposal the core of the squad that reached the final of the CONMEBOL Copa America two years ago — a feat they will aim to replicate in Canada, Mexico and the USA. After missing out on Qatar 2022, Colombia are chomping at the bit ahead of their return to the world’s biggest stage.
[...]
The squad is led by superstar Luis Diaz, who has enjoyed a sensational year at Bayern Munich, and James Rodriguez, the team captain and Colombia’s all-time leading scorer in the FIFA World Cup. James prepared for the global showpiece with a short-term move to Major League Soccer team Minnesota United.
[...]
Notably, Lorenzo has named nine midfielders to provide a number of attacking options during the tournament. "In tournaments like the World Cup, it is crucial to have options in the midfield; we aim to cover that area comprehensively," he said.

results.title: Nestor Lorenzo Announces Colombia World Cup Squad Amid James Injury Concerns
highlights:
Nestor Lorenzo Announces Colombia World Cup Squad Amid James Injury Concerns

# Nestor Lorenzo Announces Colombia World Cup Squad Amid James Injury Concerns
[...]
Colombia national team manager Nestor Lorenzo announced his definitive 26-man squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup during a press conference on Monday, May 25, 2026, prioritizing current form over historical hierarchy.
[...]
The roster selection highlighted the inclusion of team captain James Rodriguez despite recent fitness concerns, alongside the notable exclusion of forward Rafael Santos Borre in favor of Juan Camilo Hernandez.
[...]
Lorenzo addressed the physical status of Rodriguez, who missed several training sessions due to minor physical discomforts ahead of the tournament in Mexico, Canada, and the United States.
[...]
The manager further elaborated on the midfielder's status later in the press conference, reassuring supporters that the preventative measures implemented by the coaching staff had successfully resolved the issue.
[...]
The selection process required evaluating competitive league levels, physical conditioning, recent injuries, and club continuity from an initial 55-player preliminary list, which led to difficult roster decisions regarding the forward line.
[...]
The manager also noted that tactical plans changed after a friendly match against Costa Rica was rescheduled from May 29 to June 1, forcing the staff to release the final roster before the FIFA deadline rather than utilizing an expanded squad.
[...]
"La idea era preparar el partido del 29 como un banco de prueba (...) pero como el partido se pasó a posterior a la fecha que FIFA nos da para entregar la lista definitiva, pensamos que era mejor dar la lista ahora" explained the strategist.
[...]
When questioned about his institutional future beyond his current contract, which expires in July, the manager declined to guarantee his continuity with the national federation.
[...]
"No lo sé. Por ahora, hasta que tengo contrato sí. Me preparo para el Mundial, nada más. No pienso después del Mundial. Dios dirá" responded the manager.
[...]
Following the squad announcement, striker Rafael Santos Borre shared his reaction on social media regarding his omission from the final World Cup roster.
[...]
“Con mucha tristeza por no poder cumplir el sueño de jugar una Copa del Mundo, pero con la tranquilidad de haber dado todo para estar ahí. Hoy apoyaré desde otro lugar, alentando a mis compañeros y a nuestra selección como un colombiano más. Seremos más de 50 millones de corazones latiendo por ustedes" wrote the Internacional forward.
[...]
Colombia will continue its final tournament preparations ahead of competing in Group K.

results.title: Colombia’s World Cup tune-up revealed a combination that could be one of the tournament’s biggest stories - AS USA
highlights:
Colombia’s World Cup tune-up revealed a combination that could be one of the tournament’s biggest stories - AS USA
[...]
The wait is over. World Cup season has arrived, and Colombia’s national team celebrated its traditional farewell match at El Campín Stadium in Bogotá with a convincing 3-1 victory over Costa Rica in front of more than 30,000 supporters. The game also gave head coach Néstor Lorenzo an opportunity to test different combinations and hand minutes to most of the players selected for the tournament.
[...]
. Luis Díaz and Juan Camilo Hernández looked to unlock the defense through individual plays, receiving passes threaded through from midfield.
[...]
Colombia responded immediately and opened the scoring with their first meaningful attack. Following a corner delivered by Luis Díaz, Davinson Sánchez beat his marker to the ball and powered a header past goalkeeper Kevin Chamorro Sequeira, giving the home side a deserved lead.
[...]
The goal boosted Colombia’s confidence, and the second arrived in the 23rd minute. After capitalizing on a Costa Rican mistake while playing out from the back, Carlos Andrés Gómez won possession. Richard Ríos and Gustavo Puerta combined in the buildup before Luis Díaz cut inside and fired a precise shot into the net to double the advantage.
[...]
. Mora drove directly
[...]
Orlando Galo
[...]
Colombia managed the remainder of the first half comfortably and emerged with greater attacking intent after the break following the introductions of Jhon Arias, Luis Javier Suárez, Jhon Lucumí and captain James Rodríguez. The changes had an immediate impact, and the Díaz-Suárez-James partnership offered a glimpse of what Colombia hopes to showcase at the World Cup.
[...]
With the World Cup opener now just 16 days away, Colombia adopted a more measured approach as the second half progressed. Without abandoning its attacking identity, the team focused on protecting the lead and circulating possession in the opposition half while searching for openings.
[...]
The final blow came from the team’s leading scorer. James Rodríguez produced a brilliant long-range pass from his own half into the path of Luis Suárez, who timed his run perfectly, outmuscled his defender and unleashed a thunderous left-footed strike. The shot crashed off the crossbar and into the net in the 81st minute, sealing the 3-1 victory.
[...]
Colombia will remain in training camp in Bogotá until June 4 before traveling to San Diego for a second FIFA international window friendly against Jordan. The match will serve as the final step before the team officially begins its World Cup journey.

## Colombia World Cup roster 2026
[...]
Lorenzo named his preliminary squad on May 14 at a news conference, and the final list was confirmed in the final week of the month.
[...]
Teams had until Monday, May 11 to submit to FIFA an official preliminary list of 35-55 players, from which they are required to name a final roster by Saturday, May 30.
[...]
## Colombia injuries ahead of World Cup
[...]
The big concern before the tournament was around James Rodriguez. The experienced playmaker was hospitalised in March and spent three days being treated for severe dehydration. He did manage two appearances for Minnesota United in May, registering two assists in a 2-2 MLS draw with Austin.
[...]
## Colombia players to watch at World Cup
[...]
Luis Diaz is the standout star of this team and will be making his World Cup debut this year. The Bayern Munich winger had an exceptional season in Germany and will provide Colombia's biggest creative spark alongside James.
[...]
## Who is Colombia coach at the World Cup?
[...]
Lorenzo has been in charge of Colombia since June 2022. The Argentinian took over from Reinaldo Rueda after the latter had failed to secure qualification for the World Cup in Qatar.
[...]
Lorenzo's first two years in charge were hugely promising. They beat Germany for the very first time in a 2023 friendly as part of an unbeaten streak that spanned 28 games until the final of the 2024 Copa America, in which they lost to Argentina after extra time.
[...]
They finished third in the 2026 qualifying cycle, ending the phase level on points with Uruguay, Brazil and Paraguay. They beat both Argentina and the Selecao during that successful qualification run.
[...]
Lorenzo's results against some of the biggest footballing nations in the world, not to mention a commitment to an exciting playing style, has won him plenty of admirers. Yet his achievements have created a higher level of expectation ahead of these finals, and how he handles that will have a huge bearing on Colombia's chances.
